verdict.rationale: Airweave documents self-hosting on macOS, Linux or WSL by cloning the repo and running ./start.sh, with the dashboard served at localhost:8080. That covers the local-deployment core of the story. The evidence does not show it running embedded in-process, using local embedding or LLM models, or operating free of cloud APIs, so the 'fully local, no cloud dependency' claim is unproven. Missing for 10: embedded in-process mode, documented local model support (embeddings and LLM for agentic search), an explicit offline/no-cloud-dependency guarantee, independent hands-on confirmation of a fully local deployment.
